title: The 8 Best Band Saws 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for band saws 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at band saws 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Laguna Tools MBAND1412-175 14 x 12 Bandsaw
products.blurb: Key specs: 14-inch wheel, 12-inch resaw height, Ceramic blade guides, 2 HP 1-phase motor.
strengths: Ceramic blade guides eliminate the tracking and friction issues of steel guides
12-inch resaw height handles boards wider than most home woodworkers need to resaw
2 HP motor runs without bogging under full resaw depth in hardwood
Micro-adjust fence is precision enough for veneer slicing
limitations: Large footprint for a small shop
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: WEN 3962T Two-Speed Band Saw with Stand
products.blurb: Key specs: 10-inch wheels, Two speeds: 1,520 and 2,620 FPM, 3.5-inch resaw height.
strengths: Lowest price in the variable-speed bandsaw category
Two speeds enable basic control between wood and metal cutting
Small footprint fits in tight shop spaces
WEN warranty and customer service are good for the price tier
limitations: 3.5-inch resaw height limits to thin lumber only
Steel blade guides require frequent adjustment
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Rikon 10-305 Bandsaw with Fence
products.blurb: Key specs: 10-inch wheels, 4.5-inch resaw height, Precision fence included.
strengths: RIKON blade guides are the best in the beginner bandsaw category -- less drift than WEN
Precision fence allows repeatable resaw cuts for consistent lumber thickness
4.5-inch resaw height handles most box-making and smaller resawing tasks
RIKON builds better than WEN in the same price range, with tighter tolerances
limitations: Still limited to thinner boards compared to 14-inch saws
Higher price than the WEN for similar wheel size

products.name: JET JWBS-14CS 14-Inch Bandsaw
products.blurb: Key specs: 14-inch wheels, 6-inch resaw height, Enclosed stand.
strengths: 14-inch wheels allow longer blade life and better blade tracking than 10-inch saws
6-inch resaw height is adequate for most furniture-making resawing tasks
JET quality control is consistently above Grizzly and Powermatic for the same price
Enclosed stand integrates storage and provides a stable base
limitations: 6-inch resaw height is less than the Laguna 14|12's 12 inches
Motor is 1 HP -- can bog in full-width hardwood resawing

products.name: Grizzly G0555LX Deluxe Bandsaw
products.blurb: Key specs: 14-inch wheels, 6.25-inch resaw height, 1.5 HP motor.
strengths: Best price-to-capacity ratio in the 14-inch bandsaw category
1.5 HP motor handles harder domestic species at full depth
6.25-inch resaw capacity covers typical furniture and box-making tasks
Grizzly factory direct pricing eliminates retail markup
limitations: Grizzly QC varies between units -- inspect thoroughly at delivery
Direct-order only -- cannot inspect at a dealer before purchase

products.name: Powermatic 1791216K PWBS-14CS Woodworking Bandsaw
products.blurb: Key specs: 14-inch wheels, 6-inch resaw height, 1.75 HP motor.
strengths: Auto-tensioning: blade tension releases automatically when the saw is turned off, extending blade life
1.75 HP motor is the most powerful in the 14-inch non-Laguna category
Powermatic fit and finish is the best in class at this wheel size
Excellent fence system included in the package
limitations: Resaw height is 6 inches -- same as JET at a higher price
High price compared to Grizzly and JET for equivalent wheel size
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Shop Fox W1706 14-Inch 1 HP Bandsaw
products.blurb: Key specs: Cast iron upper and lower wheels, Extruded aluminum fence and rails, 6-inch resaw height (12-inch with optional riser block kit).
strengths: Cast iron wheels and enclosed cabinet stand give this saw more mass and stability than benchtop models
Upper and lower ball-bearing blade guides track cleanly with less adjustment than budget saws
Optional 6-inch extension block kit increases resaw height to 12 inches for wide-board work
Deluxe aluminum fence and rails give accurate, repeatable resaw cuts
limitations: 6-inch stock resaw height requires the extension kit for wider boards
Heavier and larger footprint than benchtop bandsaws -- needs floor space
features: Cast iron upper and lower wheels
6-inch resaw height (12-inch with optional riser block kit)

products.name: Milwaukee 2429-21XC M12 Cordless Sub-Compact Bandsaw Kit
products.blurb: Key specs: M12 cordless, 2.5-inch cut capacity, Variable speed trigger.
strengths: Cordless operation for job sites, outdoor woodworking, and spaces without outlet access
2.5-inch capacity handles rough lumber, branches, and log processing
Variable speed trigger provides cutting control for different materials
Integrates with Milwaukee M12 battery system if already in the ecosystem
limitations: 2.5-inch capacity is significantly less than benchtop bandsaws
Battery life limits run time for extended cutting sessions

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
